verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents subscribable webhooks beyond relayed authorisation, including Transfer and Dispute types, and payment-event webhooks that fire when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts. This plausibly covers post-auth money movement, but the evidence never names clearings, refunds, reversals or chargebacks individually, and never describes stable transaction identifiers linking auth to later events. Missing for 10: explicit per-event coverage of clearing, refund, reversal and chargeback; documented stable transaction IDs linking auth to post-auth events; ledger-reconciliation guidance; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, post-auth events are as programmatic as auth — clearings, refunds, reversals, and chargebacks arrive as webhooks with stable transaction identifiers, so my own ledger never drifts

citations.quote: You can subscribe to the following webhooks: Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, Report
These webhooks inform you when a merchant initiates a payment, and when funds have been added to or deducted from balance accounts.
